annotations.title: Revise one scene of a draft

description: Change ONE scene of a draft in place: its narration (scriptText), its visualPrompt and/or its durationSeconds. Scene numbers start at 1 (see get_draft). Only the fields you pass change. Screened like any prompt. Free; draft only. Requires the "video:create" scope.

scriptText.description: The narration of this scene, exactly as it will be spoken.

visualPrompt.description: What the image should show. Leave empty to let StoryShort write it at render.
